attested on carrier

  • CURIE: gmeow:attestedOnCarrier
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/attestedOnCarrier
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/lexicon

The physical archaeological carrier on which an attested form was observed — a tablet, ostracon, seal, coin, manuscript, or wall. NON-FUNCTIONAL: an attestation may reference multiple carriers (e.g. duplicate impressions), and competing carrier attributions coexist (Principle 9). This is the language-facing hook from UsageAttestation to archaeological evidence.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:UsageAttestation -> gmeow:PhysicalObject

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:attestedOnCarrier from gmeow:UsageAttestation to gmeow:PhysicalObject when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:UsageAttestation, gmeow:PhysicalObject
